data: What is the lower possible score?

The y-axis represents the score(w), which ranges from -1 to 1. The x-axis represents rank(w). The black line shows the average sentiment score for all words, while the red dashed line shows the average sentiment score for non-metaphorical words. The lowest point on the black line appears to be around -1. Therefore, the lower possible score is approximately -1.
